name: Sour Lionfish 18
author: mobinkakei
description: Rounded green checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #ddd to #08bb68, opacity becomes 1, transform becomes translate(-50%, -50%) rotateZ(40deg) scale(1).
html:
<label class="checkbox-wrapper">
<input checked="" type="checkbox" id="check" hidden="">
<label for="check" class="checkmark"></label>
</label>
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sour Lionfish 18</title>
<style>
/* Sour Lionfish 18 by mobinkakei — https://uiverse.io/mobinkakei/sour-lionfish-18 */
.checkmark {
 display: block;
 width: 30px;
 height: 30px;
 background-color: #ddd;
 border-radius: 10px;
 position: relative;
 transition: background-color 0.4s;
 overflow: hidden;
 cursor: pointer;
}

#check:checked ~ .checkmark {
 background-color: #08bb68;
}

.checkmark::after {
 content: "";
 position: absolute;
 width: 5px;
 height: 10px;
 border-right: 3px solid #fff;
 border-bottom: 3px solid #fff;
 top: 44%;
 left: 50%;
 transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotateZ(40deg) scale(10);
 opacity: 0;
 transition: all 0.4s;
}

#check:checked ~ .checkmark::after {
 opacity: 1;
 transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotateZ(40deg) scale(1);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<label class="checkbox-wrapper">
<input checked="" type="checkbox" id="check" hidden="">
<label for="check" class="checkmark"></label>
</label>

</body>
</html>
